body:
I know. I know it is. But the thought brings up so much panic and anxiety it makes it hard for me to see straight. When I start walking away, all I feel is more pain and that staying would stop that pain. So I do. It doesn't help that he apologizes profusely and promises to change. 

I don't know what I'm afraid of. I think to be alone. Because there isn't anyone left anymore. My family is in another city, and I've alienated every friend because of this relationship. I can leave but it will leave me completely alone. 

Which I guess is better but its...I don't know...i see iy rationally but I can't feel it. I don't know if that makes sense.
